hook: Cantonment Board votes to make *4* public roads Defence land
hook_b: Cantonment Board votes to make *4* public roads Defence land
tldr: SCB passed a resolution on November 27 to move Richardson, Protnee, Barr and Rajendra Singhji roads from Class C to Class A1 Defence land; FNECS objects and fears closures.

beats.what: At its November 27 meeting, the Secunderabad Cantonment Board unanimously resolved to reclassify four roads from Class 'C' to Class 'A1' Defence land, after Telangana Andhra Sub Area (TASA) sought it.
beats.why: FNECS says the roads have been used by civilians for decades and no one from the affected colonies was consulted; it wants at least an official notice.
beats.care: FNECS says residents of Kowkoor, Yapral, Balaji Nagar, Sainikpuri and AS Rao Nagar already take longer, costlier detours, and fears the roads may be closed.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The four roads: Richardson Road (Unnikrishnan Marg), Protnee Road (Tarpore Marg), Barr Road (Kowkoor Army Road) and Rajendra Singhji Road. FNECS says the public has right of way on both A1 and C roads under CLAR.

cards.q: Cantonment roads used by civilians for decades: who should decide if they stay open?

qs: What happens to colonies that rely on these roads if they close?
Has the Centre been asked to approve the change yet?

facts.t: FNECS names *5* colonies hit by road restrictions: Kowkoor, Yapral, Balaji Nagar, Sainikpuri, AS Rao Nagar.

viz.verdict: Most of the length is one 2 km stretch; residents of north-east Secunderabad use these roads.

learn.t: A1 Defence land = cantonment land under the Army's active use; Class C land is managed by the Cantonment Board.

watch: Whether the Centre approves the reclassification and whether SCB issues a public notice.

twist: Residents' federation FNECS says under cantonment land rules only the *Central government* can reclassify such land.
